comparison.objective: Gently insert a stir bar into a tilted round-bottom flask and restore it to its ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fragile-vessel holding, tilt control and small-object insertion/release.
comparison.success_condition: Bar inside, flask upright and released in ring; excessive impact, table contact, tipping or bar escape fails.
comparison.reason: Tests damage-avoiding insertion into fragile glassware, not adjustment of a locked mechanism or repeated dynamic-response convergence. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
